bends.note: runs north-south above, then slants south-south-west

ends.note: ends at the railroad along the top
dead end at estate line, east of slanting avenue

notes: Wide avenue across the top third (y 1830-1915, about 100 ft) not named within the strip ('?'). Slanting avenue running from (5245,1830) south to (4885,5380) printed only 'AVENUE'; name not read ('?'). Cross streets from the west at y 2210 and 2662 print 'AVENUE', at 3108 and 3555 'STREET'; names lie west of the strip and were not read. Street along north of Avon Field's Sub printed 'STREET' only. Bottom avenue printed 'AVENUE' only; two stubs to the south cut by the plate edge, names partly printed ('...WICK AVE', '...FORD AVE'). Large 'HENRY ...' lettering beside the slanting avenue is taken as subdivision lettering.
